item.title: Numerous holes in the road where the cats eyes were removed, 23rd July
item.description:
When the cycle path was built the width of the carriageway was reduced. As part of this the cats eyes were moved. Where they were dug up some weren't filled and some were filled but have since sunk. This has left holes in the road which causes damage to cars and makes you swerve to avoid them. They will only get bigger when the weather deteriorates. The cycle path is smoother than the carriageway!
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Evesham Road, Marle Hill, Cheltenham, Cheltenham

item.description:

It is only like this at the Bishops Cleeve end of the road, the Cheltenham end has been filled with a coloured concrete which looks a lot better. Why has the Bishops Cleeve end been left to look tatty?

item.title: Massive pot hole on the way towards the round about from Cheltenham., 23rd July
item.description:
The pothole is on a left bend towards the round about it’s hard to miss. I’ve hit it and it instantly burst my front left tyre and caused damage to my rim, it’s taken a big gash out of the side wall on my back left. Whilst I was there changing my tyre two people had already hit it and was doing the same as me. One person drove past in a truck with off road tyres on and that had a deflated tyre after hitting it too.
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): B4070, Coberley, Cotswold
Report on FixMyStreet

item.title: White lines indicating parking on eastbound side of Church Road almost disappeared. Many of us have mirrors smashed by traffic trying to squeeze past, often at speed. Very costly. I now place an orange cone (see photo) WITHIN the parking space and even the cone gets knocked over or crushed. And my car is very small compared to most. Full mirror £424 a few weeks ago as even electrics damaged., 23rd July
item.description:
The parking space line all along this stretch is almost disappeared. Please please repaint it asap. It might help drivers to be more respectful. The volume of traffic as I’m sure you know, has tripled during last couple of years as drivers avoid Shurdington Road.

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): 71, Church Road, Warden Hill, Cheltenham
